note: Every environment variable that tracked Python code reads and that a person does not put in .env. env_file lists the settings of .env in the order of .env.example. Categories: test (only test code uses it), container (Terraform, ECS, Airflow, a job template or the launcher sets it inside a container; set_in names the file that sets one that no infra or job config sets, set_by ecs marks one that ECS sets and set_by alias with set_in marks one that code sets through a constant the check does not follow), shell (an optional override that a person may export for one command) and tool (the OS or a tool sets it). test_modules are test-only files that the TEST_CODE path rule in scripts/quality/repo_checks.py does not match. The env-example check keeps this file and .env.example in step with the code. Never put a real value in this file.

test_modules.scripts/infrastructure/systemd_model.py: The systemd stand-in of the host boot cases; only scripts/infrastructure/run_e2e.py uses it.
